reason: I only put paint on my walls from the brands I see on TV and can ask for by name at the shop, and I have never heard of Turbolux. The written price and the pay-after-checking terms are nice, but I am not trying a new paint brand on my own home after six years of waiting to repaint.
objection: Who is Turbolux? If the paint is not a name brand, I don't know whether it will last, and a 3-year guarantee from a company new to Kochi is only good if they are still around in 3 years.
would_change_my_mind: If the same crew, fixed written price and late-day penalty came with Asian Paints or Berger paint on my walls, or if I could see a neighbour's flat they painted a few years ago still looking good.
